This is a great costume to land. It makes a useful hero much easier to keep alive. Level the costume first for the stats, but don't neglect the base version's emblem path if you have Monk emblems to spare (though you'll likely emblem the costume's Rogue path).
The costume is a "quality of life" upgrade. It doesn't change how you use him, it just makes him better at it. If you have him Limit Broken, the costume makes that investment even better.

Costumed Joukahainen isn't a flashy reinvention; it's a fortification. He takes a hero who was already excellent mechanically and gives him the physical stats to compete in a more violent meta. While he might not be the most exciting pull compared to a brand new event hero, he is the reliable workhorse you'll be thankful for every time a Rush Tournament rolls around.
A solid, necessary upgrade for a 3-star hall-of-famer.
